item.title: ▫️ Night is his element: the feat of the crew of Aziz Kudryakov During the special military operation,
item.description: Night is his element: the feat of the crew of Aziz Kudryakov ▫️ During the special military operation, his crew carried out 437 sorties, most of them under cover of darkness. Kudryakov destroyed the enemy's tanks and SAM systems, demonstrating the highest professionalism. 🚁 The last manoeuvre: defeating the enemy in Kursk border, the crew of the commander, Aziz Kudryakov, and the navigation officer, Mikhail Lazis, used all ammunition during the flight. When they were on their way to the base, they saw an enemy drone rushing into the residential sector, and they decided to perform ram manoeuver. ▫️ The crew sacrificed itself to save hundreds of civilians from death. ▫️ By presidential decree, the commander of the crew, Aziz Kudryakov, was awarded the title of Hero of the Russian Federation (postmortem). The navigation officer Mikhail Lazis was awarded the Order for Courage (postmortem). 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🛠 Front-line inventors in action The Zapad Group of Forces deployed a workshop to assemble and modernise drones
item.description: Front-line inventors in action 🛠 The Zapad Group of Forces deployed a workshop to assemble and modernise drones in Krasny Liman direction. ➡️ How the work is organised: ▫️ Case-by-case approach. Craftsmen modernise every drone manually. They upgrade the construction and upload unique OS to make it perform a specific task. ▫️ Maximum speed. A prepared drone doesn't stay in a warehouse. Craftsmen immediately send it to the front line. ▫️ Rapid reaction. Closeness to the front line makes it possible to respond instantly to any change in the situation. Our units receive the necessary equipment without delay. ▫️ With such craftsmen, our servicemen will hit any targets! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ✏️ Taking care of our future The servicemen of the Tsentr Group of Forces and volunteers from the Volga region handed over backpacks with office supplies and school uniforms to the
item.description: Taking care of our future ✏️ The servicemen of the Tsentr Group of Forces and volunteers from the Volga region handed over backpacks with office supplies and school uniforms to the students of the Donetsk Rehabilitation Centre on the occasion of the Knowledge Day. 📕 The centre was also gifted with a school album found under the rubble in Avdeyevka: after restoration, it will be sent to the museum as a symbol of the return to peaceful life. The children sang to their guests, and our servicemen promised to continue to support them. ❤️ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🔥
In Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at formations of four mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and two territorial defence brigades close to Prikolotnoye, Gogino, Slatino, Izbitskoye, Novoaleksandrovka, and Podsredneye in Kharkov region.
▪️
The AFU lost more than 230 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades were hit close to Izyumskoye, Staroverovka, Grushevka, Peski-Radkovskiye, Maleevka, Prokopovka (Kharkov region), Svyatogorsk, and Karpovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted more than 210 troops, a U.S.-made M1117 armoured personnel carrier, a Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, a Canadian-made Titan-S armoured vehicle, and 20 motor vehicles.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Formations of three mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, a mountain assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade were hit near Klinovoye, Rayskoye, Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Nikanorovka, Novoselovka, Druzhkovka and Kondratovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 240 troops, a U.S.-made Stryker armoured personnel carrier, 26 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one Grad MLRS combat vehicle.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades were hit near Belozerskoye, Andreyevka, Starorayskoye, Veselaya Gora, Dobropolye, Slavyanka, Fedorovka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▫️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 375 troops, a Canadian-made Senator armoured fighting vehicle, seven motor vehicles, and three field artillery guns.

item.title: 💥 During the night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to deliver group strikes against Ukrainian defence industry enterprises
item.description: 💥 During the night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to deliver group strikes against Ukrainian defence industry enterprises used in the interests of the AFU. ▫️ Strike UAVs hit a cement plant , whose warehouses were used to store explosives for the benefit of the Smart Ammunition LLC in Kiev .
